diagnostic_title: F5 Preregistered Independent Temporal Integration Macro and Gauge Diagnostic

budget_source.derivation: macro_relative_error_budget * integration_error_share = 0.05 * 0.20 = 0.01 (1.0% relative error = 4.0 mm absolute tolerance)
budget_source.registration_status: Formally read from frozen F5 quality_contract.json; not an unregistered claim.

primary_metrics: normalized_eta_rmse_m / H_ref (must be <= 0.010 for temporal pass)

outcome_temporal_converged.condition: Normalized RMSE / H <= 0.01 (<= 4.0 mm) across all 6 gauges for both mechanisms
outcome_temporal_converged.scientific_implication: Baseline fine execution is rigorously confirmed to be temporally converged within the 1% contract budget.
outcome_temporal_converged.impact_on_prior_spatial_failure: The 12% Medium-vs-Fine spatial error observed at always-wet probes WG1 and WG2 is conclusively proven to be independent of temporal integration errors. The spatial convergence failure of the 3DP ladder remains an authentic negative result.

outcome_temporal_unconverged.condition: Normalized RMSE / H > 0.01 (> 4.0 mm) on any probe or mechanism
outcome_temporal_unconverged.scientific_implication: Baseline fine execution exhibits non-negligible temporal discretization sensitivity at CFL=0.2, CoefDtMin=0.05.
outcome_temporal_unconverged.impact_on_prior_spatial_failure: The baseline spatial comparison was corrupted by temporal integration error, and spatial convergence was never demonstrated. The spatial failure stays strictly negative.

falsification_and_permanence_matrix.governing_permanence_rule: The prior always-wet ~12% spatial failure stays negative whichever temporal result occurs. Temporal qualification cannot retrospectively alter or rescue the negative spatial finding; it provides the missing independent verification required by quality_contract.json.
